svg.title: Triton and TensorRT on a single L4
svg.desc: Triton Inference Server with nine TensorRT FP16 engines on one NVIDIA L4 GPU.
svg.text: Triton and TensorRT on a single L4
Nine TensorRT FP16 engines behind Triton, a gunicorn gateway and nginx; every request
archived to S3 and DynamoDB through a retrying spool that never blocks the response.
